_about: Copy for the rebuilt home page (start.html). Every claim is checkable in this repo. No figure that the app does not derive, no price, no date, no social proof. No stamped fms figure tokens are used here; only start.html itself is stamped by vite.config.js startFigures().

hero.h1: From first draft to final call sheet
hero.sub: For indie directors, writers and line producers. Write the script, break it down and plan the shoot in one place, saved in your own browser.

stages.body: A screenplay writer for Tamil, Tanglish and English. The format sets itself as you type, drafts are numbered, and every scene heading becomes a scene the rest of the studio can use.
Place your beats on one of eleven story structures, check where the pacing sags, then give each planned shot a frame on the storyboard.
Auto-tag suggests what each scene needs and you accept what is right. Then build the shot list, lay scenes onto a stripboard, and print the sides for the day.
A budget in rupees that starts from dated Chennai rates, and a call sheet for each shoot day that you can print or send on WhatsApp.
Everything you write is saved in your own browser first, and the studio installs like an app and keeps working offline. Sync and a backup to your own Google Drive are there if you switch them on.
